po.name: Engineering knowledge
po.definition: Apply mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals and domain knowledge.

po.name: Problem analysis
po.definition: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyse complex engineering problems.

po.name: Design/development of solutions
po.definition: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components.

po.name: Conduct investigations
po.definition: Use research-based knowledge and methods including experiment design and data analysis.

po.name: Modern tool usage
po.definition: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering tools.

po.name: The engineer and society
po.definition: Apply contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues.

po.name: Environment and sustainability
po.definition: Understand the impact of engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts.

po.name: Ethics
po.definition: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities.

po.name: Individual and team work
po.definition: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse teams.

po.name: Communication
po.definition: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities.

po.name: Project management and finance
po.definition: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering and management principles.

po.name: Life-long learning
po.definition: Recognize the need for and engage in independent and life-long learning.

pso.name: Domain application
pso.definition: Apply domain-specific concepts and tools to solve discipline problems.

pso.name: Professional practice
pso.definition: Develop solutions that reflect professional practice and current technologies.
